reply.image_seen: Image 1 shows four dark steel ladder facings together; image 2 shows two exposed hooks; image 3 shows a foreshortened side ladder with thick stringers and four visible rungs; image 4 shows a tapered ladder between hooked guide rails; image 5 mirrors the side ladder; image 6 places the lowered facings around a pit beside a human; image 7 compares lowered and raised wall compositions, with sparse raised side assemblies; image 8 shows the raised north ladder projecting above its hooked guide rails.

concerns.evidence: In image 7, the raised east/west assemblies have long exposed guide bars, short upright ends and a narrow cluster of vertical members near the outer rim. They lose the continuous rung sequence visible in the lowered sides and read as fragmented frames. The separate variants_2.png and variants_3.png are absent, but this problem is visible in wall_context.png.

Images 7 and 8 show raised north retaining a complete rung-bearing ladder extending well above the hooked rail tops. The raised sides in image 7 lack an equally recognizable ladder extending outward past those hooks. Small projecting members are present, but they do not establish the same sliding assembly.

In image 7's raised sides, the exposed horizontal guide bars and widely separated upright pieces are readable individually, but a ladder held between two guides is difficult to identify. This contrasts with the plainly recognizable raised north ladder.

Image 6 and the lowered half of image 7 show the side ladders compressed across the light wall-face bands, with their long axes running east-west on screen and their inner ends reaching approximately the wall-to-floor boundary. The shallow slopes of their individual stringers do not establish a shallow physical lean; the wall compositions show the required steep, foreshortened placement.

Images 3 and 5 show only four distinct, approximately evenly spaced rung members between the stringers, while image 4 shows a substantially longer rung sequence with gaps narrowing downward. The side views consequently resemble short grilles and do not preserve the north ladder's visible rung structure.

The card specifies no code-defined ports, and the supplied sprites show hooks and ladder hardware without obvious hose or cord connectors. However, no identified in-game assembled capture is supplied, so the template's unconditional assembled PORTS check cannot be completed.
The wall-context composition shows intended placement, but it does not establish runtime draw-layer order. An identified in-game assembled capture of both states and their rotations is missing.
